title: not possible to scroll in preferences page or open subpreferences
symptom: On Android 12, when trying to navigate or change preferences, the window always returns up when scrolling down, and entering another preference section returns to the first preference page, making it impossible to scroll or open subpreferences.
cause: The issue occurs when the lockscreen wallpaper feature is turned on in Android 12 beta.
fix: Disable the lockscreen wallpaper feature in Android 12 settings.
evidence_quote: I have found this happens if the lockscreen wallpaper feature is turned on when running Android 12 beta.
